title: AES standard on interconnections — Grounding and EMC practices — Shields of balanced audio wiring within fixed and portable installations
abstract: Specifies the shielding and grounding practices for balanced audio wiring installed in fixed architectural facilities and portable installations, addressing line level and microphone level interconnects.

standardized_levels.line_level: Audio signal transmitted at reference RMS voltage between 0.25 V and 2 V RMS (practical range: few millivolts to 15 V).
standardized_levels.microphone_level: Audio signal transmitted at output levels specified by IEC 61938 for electrodynamic and capacitor microphones (nominal: 1 mV to 10 mV; practical range: few microvolts to 1 V).

shield_grounding_architectures.single_point_shielding: Shield grounded at driving end only; provides low-frequency electrostatic shielding but degrades RF immunity.
shield_grounding_architectures.dual_point_shielding: Shield bonded at both ends to chassis (strictly compliant with AES48); provides maximum RF shielding immunity.
shield_grounding_architectures.hybrid_rf_shielding: Direct metallic bond at driving end, capacitive termination (0.01 μF to 0.1 μF ceramic) at receiving end to bleed RF while blocking power-line ground loop currents.

relevance_to_balanced_audio: Harmonizes installation wiring rules with equipment design, bridging AES48 with field facility infrastructure.
